_note: Phase U2: a third agent process for each sub-area (53), drafted for utility SME review. Impact ranges are [validate] / BENCH.
thermal-perf: Recommend unit commitment changes that cut emissions within reliability limits
renewables-ops: Attribute curtailed MWh to grid, market and equipment causes
plant-compliance: Forecast monthly emissions against permit caps and allowances

outage-plan: Check contractor permits, qualifications and parts before outage start
gen-engineering: Check engineering changes against design basis and procedures
forecasting: Forecast day-ahead and real-time prices by node
bidding: Check offers against market rules and mitigation thresholds
fuel-risk: Explain hedge performance and recommend rebalancing within policy
irp: Draft responses to public and regulator comments with sourced assumptions
project-dev: Track queue positions, study milestones and deposits for each project
load-growth: Model heat-pump and EV adoption scenarios by feeder
interconnection: Answer applicant questions and give status from the queue
transmission-plan: Draft cost allocation analyses for network upgrades
outage-mgmt: Detect customers still out after upstream restoration using AMI pings
adms-derms: Recommend feeder load transfers to relieve overloads (operator executes)
transmission-ops: Check proposed switching orders against tags, holds and the as-operated model
asset-health: Draft failure investigations and link to fleet risk
inspection: Plan drone and patrol routes by risk and access
network-model: Recommend phase moves from AMI and connectivity data

vegetation: Verify trim work from imagery before invoice approval
wildfire: Assemble evidence for ignition investigations from SCADA, weather and assets
storm: Classify field damage photos and estimate crew-hours

dispatch: Check job completion data and photos before close-out
contractors: Score contractors on safety, quality and schedule

gas-control: Recommend storage withdrawals and pressure plans (gas controller executes)
ami: Monitor meter firmware rollouts and stop on failure trends
billing: Find bills likely to cause complaints before they are sent
revenue-protection: Assemble theft investigation cases with evidence
contact-centre: Summarise contacts and update the account record
high-bill: Estimate appliance-level usage from interval data

ev-der: Guide customers through solar and battery applications
new-service: Draft service designs and material lists for simple connections

field-safety: Flag jobs where weather or conditions change during work
incident: Track corrective actions to closure and flag overdue ones
environment: Check work against nesting seasons and permit conditions
rate-case: Reconcile revenue requirement models to the ledger
reliability-standards: Keep the critical cyber asset inventory reconciled with the network
performance-metrics: Draft annual reliability reports from certified metrics
